name: znote
setup: . scripts/env.sh && mkdir -p "$ENV" && cd "$SRC" && rm -rf node_modules && npm install --before=2026-10-13T00:00:00Z --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error --no-package-lock

. scripts/env.sh && mkdir -p "$ENV/tools" && echo '{"private":true}' > "$ENV/tools/package.json" && npm install --before=2026-10-13T00:00:00Z --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error --prefix "$ENV/tools" typescript@5.9.3
notes: Node v24.19.0, npm 11. Bun server app (Hono + Mastra agents over the AI SDK, backend/); the repo ships bun.lock only and bun is not installed here, so setup runs npm install --before=2026-10-13 from package.json (no lockfile written), plus typescript 5.9.3 into $ENV/tools (the repo has no typescript dependency). No test suite and no CI, so test_kind=typecheck: test_cmd writes $ENV/tsconfig.backend.json extending the copy's tsconfig.json (strict, bundler resolution, @/* -> backend/*) with include backend/**/*.ts, skipLibCheck, typeRoots pointing at the copy's node_modules/@types (@types/bun), and runs tsc on it. It covers all 33 backend .ts files, including the LLM ones (backend/api/ai.ts, backend/db/mastra.ts, backend/db/vector.ts). The frontend (Vue, separate package) has no LLM calls and is not checked. Baseline: exit 0, 0 'error TS', identical over 2 runs.
